found.quote: The University will provide information, training, guidance and other supports to students and staff to facilitate the effective implementation of this policy.

found.name: Academic Integrity Officer
found.quote: The Academic Integrity Officer is a central university role responsible for educating staff and students on academic integrity and supporting all relevant parties in dealing with alleged cases of academic misconduct.

found.name: Students' Union sabbatical officer
found.quote: The student may bring a student colleague of their choice or a sabbatical officer of the Students’ Union to any meeting held under this policy and associated procedure.
